items.name: Tia Maria project, Peru
items.claim: As of June 30, 2026, Southern Copper had committed $1,101 million to the Tia Maria project's activities, of which $693 million had already been invested.
items.source_excerpt: As of June 30, 2026, the Company has committed $1,101 million to various project activities, of which $693 million has already been invested.

items.name: Tia Maria project completion status, Peru
items.claim: As of June 30, 2026, the Tia Maria project had reached 42% completion, and 5,817 new jobs had been created.
items.source_excerpt: As of June 30, 2026, the Tía María project had reached 42% completion, and 5,817 new jobs had been created.

notes: The stored Q2 2026 8-K exhibit also names three further Peruvian growth projects (Los Chancas $2.6 billion, Michiquillay $2.5 billion) and Mexican projects (El Pilar $551 million investment, El Arco) with estimated capital and start dates, but they carry planning-stage estimates rather than the same as-of-quarter committed/completion figures used above; only the Tia Maria items were itemized to keep each item to one dated, quantified disclosure. The queued official IR analyst-presentations page 403'd, so status is PARTIAL rather than COMPLETE even though the stored 8-K supplied usable items.
